notes: wowsims-forever models one Hunter spell package for all three specs; this is the spec the fork's own p1.apl.json preset is already built for (heavy Aimed Shot weaving), so it is the closest adaptation of the three hunter files. Marksmanship also keeps Serpent Sting up for the extra sustained damage, unlike Beast Mastery where community guides call it not worth a global. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst: the preset names Multi-Shot as spell 25294, which does not exist in this build (Multi-Shot only has one rank here, 2643), and calls Serpent Sting rank 8 when 25295 is actually rank 9 -- both fixed here rather than copied stale.
